description: Recent sessions (one connection each), newest first, with their calls, failures, tools used and calls an agent repeated with the same arguments.

client.description: Only calls from this client type, as list_clients names them, such as claude-code or cursor.

days.description: How many days back to look, ending now. 7 when left out. Ignored when from is given.

from.description: Start of the window, as an ISO 8601 date or time. Overrides days.

limit.description: How many to return. 20 when left out.

server.description: The MCP server to ask about, by name or id. Leave out when the account has only one.

to.description: End of the window, as an ISO 8601 date or time. Now when left out.

tool.description: Only sessions that called this tool.

with.description: Only sessions with failures, or with repeated calls.

name: list_sessions
title: List sessions
